column3: {actor_name:1}, he's down!{end_wait}
Mercury's light...\nIt sapped my strength.{page_break}Had I fought at full power,\nyou'd be dead already.{end_wait}
The beacon weakened you.\nWhy? What are you?{end_wait}
That is not your\nconcern...{end_wait}

The legend was true.
The beacon lit,
the spring returned.{page_break}Imil can heal again.
But what else has
that light changed?{end_wait}

I can't leave them.
Not when they've
needed me so long.{page_break}But the water is back.
And Imil has healers.
I have to trust them.{end_wait}
They're getting away.\nWe need to follow.{end_wait}
The fountain runs again.\nThe legend was true.{page_break}But who can tell us\nwhat the light will cost?{end_wait}
Our fountain is back.\nThey say these waters\nheal all that lives.{end_wait}

I drank the healing
water, and I feel
strong again.{page_break}I'll take a bottle
home. Just in case.{end_wait}
The fever is gone.\nI pray it stays gone.{end_wait}
How did the fountain\nknow the beacon\nwas lit?{end_wait}
All that lives... It must\nwork on plants and\nanimals, too.{end_wait}
I thought I'd die here.\nNow I can stand again.{page_break}I should be grateful.\nWhy am I still afraid?{end_wait}
I never believed those\nstories, but there's\nthe proof.{end_wait}

He who honors the heart
of the goddess shall stand
at the center of all,{page_break}like a swan in the
center of a rippling
pond.{end_wait}
He who honors the\ngoddess of rainbows shall{page_break}be guided to the heavens\nupon wings of fluid grace.{end_wait}
The door is shut tight.{end_wait}
The fountain is flowing\nwith water.{end_wait}
The fountain seems dry.{end_wait}
Strange forces are at\nwork... It seems\nimpossible to proceed.{end_wait}
One,{pause_20_skippable} two,{pause_20_skippable} three,{pause_20_skippable} four...{end_wait}
I trained hard to\nwithstand any disease...{page_break}And now the fountain\nis back?{end_now}
What did I train\nso hard for all this time?{end_wait}
No, it can't be! Everyone\nis in perfect health!{end_wait}
We'll care for Imil,\n{actor_name:4}. You taught us\nwhat to do.{end_wait}

Now that I've let my
guard down, I'm getting
chills.{page_break}Maybe I should drink
some fountain water.{end_wait}
That fountain water\nmade Grandpa healthy\nagain.{end_wait}
Did I really say\nI was going to die\nfrom that sickness?{end_now}

Ha ha ha! I must have
felt terrible to say
that!{page_break}I'm good for another 30
years!{pause_20_skippable} ...Back to work!{end_wait}
That's right!\nThe strong old man of\nImil, that's me!{end_wait}
Grandpa's all better\nnow, thanks to the\nfountain water.{end_wait}
That blue light from her\nhands... Is she an angel,\nor something else?{end_wait}
I have to catch up\non lost time.\nBack to business.{end_wait}
Customers are rare, and\nI can't afford to lose\neven one.{end_wait}
A shame the store was\nclosed for something\nas small as a cold.{end_wait}
The customers are back.\nI thought I'd lost my\nbusiness for good.{end_wait}
I'm fully recovered,\nthanks to the fountain.\nBack to work.{end_wait}
I'm so happy Mommy\nis well again!{end_wait}
My daddy's still in\nKolima. I'll be so happy\nif he comes home soon.{end_wait}
It's almost time for you\nto leave, isn't it?{end_now}

Just like the legend,
the fountain began to
flow when the light lit.{page_break}Imil need never fear
sickness again.{end_wait}
I'll cook a feast\nfor you tonight.{end_wait}
I never told {actor_name:4}\nthat I liked her...{page_break}Maybe it's for\nthe best.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4}...{end_wait}
We were afraid\nyou'd never come back!{end_wait}
I'm sorry I worried\nyou both.{end_wait}
{actor_name:4}, the lighthouse!\nIts beacon is lit!{end_wait}
You knew already,\n{actor_name:4}?{end_wait}
What's wrong?{pause_20_skippable}\nYou look worried,\n{actor_name:4}.{end_wait}
I...{pause_20_skippable}\nThere's something\nI must tell you.{end_wait}
What is it, Mia?\nYou can tell us.{end_wait}
Well...{pause_20_skippable}\nI don't know where\nto begin.{end_wait}
You said the world\ncould be in danger\nif the beacon lit.{end_wait}
Is that why you're\nleaving? To protect\neveryone?{end_wait}
Yes.{pause_20_skippable}\nI have to go.{end_wait}
Then we can't\nask you to stay.{end_wait}
We won't stop you.{page_break}If people need you,\nyou have to help them.{end_wait}
Thank you.{pause_20_skippable}\nI'll miss you both.{end_wait}
We're Mercury Clan,\ntoo. We'll keep\nImil safe.{page_break}Don't worry about us.{end_wait}
I'll work hard and\nlearn to heal as well\nas you, {actor_name:4}!{end_wait}
